findings.finding: A retained HLS instance loses fatal error handling after ordinary Pause/Play. Its only ERROR listener captures currentAttempt at instance creation; pause and resume increment attempt, but valid candidate resume retains hls and installs no new listener. Therefore currentAttempt !== attempt rejects every subsequent fatal error from the still-current instance, leaving Playing/Buffering and the ownership lock held.

findings.finding: Ordinary direct or native-HLS Pause/Play restores position against the old ready media and immediately clears the restore listeners, then unconditionally assigns audio.src again. The source assignment restarts loading and resets currentTime to zero, with no remaining restore callback. Thus ordinary archive resume can restart the episode despite the same valid candidate.
